The Canero Group is pleased to present 4385 SW 70th Court, a 2.26-acre industrial assemblage strategically located in the heart of Miami-Dade County.​ The site is currently improved with an 18,617 square foot single story manufacturing facility leased to Fort Dallas Truss, providing valuable in-place income while a developer pursues entitlements.​ Under Florida’s Live Local Act, the Property qualifies for administrative approval of a high-density multifamily project by right, no rezoning, no public hearings, and no comprehensive plan amendment required.​

Miami-Dade County has interpreted the Live Local Act to allow up to 250 dwelling units per acre as a by right density benchmark.​ The Property is located within 0.16 miles of a BU-2 zoning district, which under the 2026 updates to the Act may permit unlimited height for qualifying multifamily developments.​ Zoning Verification Letter J2025000054 confirms this interpretation for projects within one mile of a BU-2 district.​

To qualify, a development must consist of multifamily rental units with at least 40% of the residential units restricted as affordable to households earning up to 120% of area median income, for a minimum of 30 years.​ Affordable units are monitored through an annually renewable Certificate of Use and recorded covenants ensuring 30-year compliance.​ Mixed-use projects must dedicate at least 65% of total square footage to residential use.​

The site sits in a rapidly transitioning industrial pocket bordered by recent multifamily development, with surrounding new construction confirming the corridor’s trajectory.​ As one of the few large format, by right entitled development sites available in central Miami-Dade County, this offering represents a unique opportunity to deliver a landmark project at scale.​
